05 / GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity.

Can we start with just one service?+

Yes. Start with one service or combine a few. We agree the scope and fee before starting.

What does a project cost?+

Share your brief and budget. Lugia will send a tailored scope, fee and timeline.

Are you a new agency?+

Yes. We’re a new agency building our story through thoughtful work and direct communication.

Who will I speak with?+

Mohammed Dalvi is your point of contact for the brief, project coordination, feedback and handover.

Which locations do you work with?+

We work remotely with businesses in India, Qatar, Puerto Rico, Brazil, the USA, the UK, Italy, Spain and Australia. We agree the scope, communication and timeline around your project.

How soon can a project start?+

Share your ideal launch date with your brief. We’ll confirm availability, required inputs and a realistic timeline in the proposal before you commit.
